name: @sos-2/transfer
description: SOS 2.0 Transfer: transfer evidence as a distinct evidence class — applying a package/composition in a NEW context is recorded as context-conditioned transfer evidence whose outcomes feed the TARGET-context applicability estimate and NEVER the source's (machine-checked); specialization/generalization as typed lineage operations (SPECIALIZES / GENERALIZES frozen trace types) creating new package records with copied-forward evidence, failures and learned limitations; and first-class retained negative evidence — failed transfers, invalidated assumptions and contexts-of-failure are never dropped (Work Order W13; spec/architecture.md §5, §11, §12, §18; docs/package-ecology.md).
